# Goody

Goody is a platform that enables users to send gifts and physical products without handling logistics, offering APIs for commerce and automation.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/goody/.

## Actions

- **Calculate Price for Order Batch** (read-only): Estimate per-recipient and total price for an order batch.
- **List All Active Cards** (read-only): List all active digital greeting cards.
- **List All Active Products** (read-only): List all active products.
- **List All Order Batches** (read-only): List all order batches.
- **List All Orders** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all orders.
- **List All Payment Methods** (read-only): List all payment methods.
- **List All Workspaces** (read-only): List all workspaces.
- **Retrieve Current User** (read-only): Retrieve current authenticated user information.
- **Retrieve Product** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific product by its ID.
